hook: Read this when you feel like quitting.
lines: Nobody sees the early mornings.
Nobody claps for the reps you do alone.
But one day the results will speak so loudly
that you won't have to say a word.
caption: Keep going. The quiet work counts the most.

hook: You are closer than you think.
lines: Most people stop one step before the breakthrough.
They mistake slow progress for no progress.
Don't measure the distance left.
Measure how far you've already come.
caption: Slow progress is still progress.

hook: Discipline is a form of self-respect.
lines: Motivation gets you started.
Discipline keeps you going when the feeling is gone.
Do it tired. Do it bored. Do it anyway.
Your future self is watching.
caption: Do it anyway.

hook: Stop waiting for the perfect moment.
lines: The perfect moment is a story fear tells you.
Start with what you have, where you are.
Clarity comes from action, not from thinking.
Begin today, and adjust tomorrow.
caption: Start before you feel ready.

hook: Your habits are voting for who you become.
lines: Every small choice is a vote.
One workout. One page. One early night.
You don't need to win every vote.
You just need to win the majority.
caption: Small choices, repeated daily.

lines: You are seeing their highlight reel.
They are not seeing your behind the scenes.
Run your own race at your own pace.
The only person to beat is who you were yesterday.
caption: Run your own race.

lines: Pressure is not here to break you.
It is here to show you what you're made of.
Every storm you survived taught you something.
This one will too.
caption: You have survived every hard day so far.
